{{Quote|Kuat Drive Yards has a proud heritage of serving the Republic, and the new Delta-7s we have specifically prepared for the Jedi order will continue that tradition.|Risi Lenoan|<ref name="HNN" />}}
'''Risi Lenoan''', a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Senator/Legends|senator]] handpicked for the interests of the [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] company, represented the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] during the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], she was present at the unveiling of the [[Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7 ''Aethersprite''-class light interceptor]] at a Kuat Drive Yards testing range. Lenoan was replaced no later than [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] by the [[Kuati/Legends|Kuati]] Human [[Giddean Danu/Legends|Giddean Danu]].

==Biography==
The [[Human/Legends|Human]] Risi Lenoan,<ref name="HNN" /> a [[Kuati/Legends|native]] of<ref name="CSWE" /> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]],<ref name="CSWE" /> was a [[Senator/Legends|senator]] in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]].<ref name="DB">{{DB|character|onarakuat|Kuat, Onara}}</ref> She<ref name="CSWE" /> faithfully served in her [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld's]] senator delegate, handpicked by members of the influential [[House Kuat]] for the benefit of the [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] corporation.<ref name="DB" />

During the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]]<ref name="HNN" /> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|47|jediwatch/13314_1.html|New Jedi Starfighter Unveiled}} is set on the date 13:3:14, which corresponds to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] according to the reasoning [[Template:YearMathGRS|here]].</ref> Lenoan was present at a closed testing range used by Kuat Drive Yards for the Republic inspection and unveiling of the [[Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7 ''Aethersprite''-class light interceptor]], a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] meant for use by members of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. She, the project engineer [[Walex Blissex/Legends|Walex Blissex]], and the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]] and [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]], lauded the ship's performance in controlled conditions. Lenoan gave a speech on the Delta-7 before she cut a symbolic tether on the [[Interceptor/Legends|interceptor's]] landing gear in an ancient Kuati nautical tradition. The ceremony and the Senator's involvement were later documented by the [[HoloNet News CoCo District Edition|CoCo District Edition]] of [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]].<ref name="HNN" />

At some point no later than [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="Removal">{{Film|III}}, which is dated to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'', shows [[Giddean Danu/Legends|Giddean Danu]] active in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]. {{DB|character|onarakuat|Kuat, Onara}} establishes that Danu's tenure follows the removal of Risi Lenoan's [[Senator/Legends|senator]] position. Therefore, Lenoan must have been removed as Kuat's senator by 19 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> Leonan was removed from office after several bookkeeping and clerical errors implied she was funded by Kuat Drive Yards, though it was not clear whether the Senator received the funds legally or illegally.<ref name="CSWE" /> Lenoan was replaced by<ref name="DB" /> her fellow Kuati Human<ref name="Danu">{{DB|character|giddeandanu|Danu, Giddean}}</ref> [[Giddean Danu/Legends|Giddean Danu]] at the suggestion of [[Onara Kuat]], thinking he would bend to her will.<ref name="DB" />

==Personality and traits==
The light-skinned Senator<ref name="HNN" /> faithfully served the senator delegate, though that did not stop her removal from office.<ref name="DB" />

==Equipment==
While at the inspection of the Delta-7 interceptor, Lenosan wore [[Color/Legends|red]] [[Clothing/Legends|robes]] with gold trim, a gold sash around her waist, and a gold hat. She used a gilded [[Knife/Legends|blade]] to cut through the symbolic tether there.<ref name="HNN" />
